name: Sondos Al-Qadi
bio: 5th-year medical student passionate about cardiology and clinical research. President of CIG-BAU, focusing on education, research, and student engagement.

name: Fayez Zedat
bio: I'm a 4th-year medical student at Al-Balqa Applied University in Jordan. Cardiology drew me in through research, building predictive models on real data, like Jordan's Hakeem system, for conditions like AF and heart failure, rather than just describing them. With CIG-BAU, I built our hull structure for projects and the leadership platform, planned the restructuring of our committees and project teams, and grew our membership past 300 medicine students through advertising, engagement events, and perks.

name: Georgette Kharman
bio: I am a fourth-year medical student at Al-Balqa Applied University, and my interest in cardiovascular medicine has grown through discovering how diverse and impactful the field can be, from prevention and patient education to clinical care and intervention. My journey with CIG-BAU, from Committee Leader to Head of Medical Education and now Vice President, has allowed me to turn that interest into meaningful experiences by leading and organizing educational events, awareness initiatives, conferences, and opportunities that bring medical students closer to the field of cardiology.

name: Joelle Kharman
bio: I am a second-year medical student and currently serve as the Head of the Medical Education and Workshop Committee in CIG. What drew me to cardiovascular medicine is how central the heart is to nearly every aspect of the body, and how understanding it combines physiology, clinical reasoning, prevention, and patient care. Through CIG, I contribute by developing educational initiatives, organizing workshops and awareness activities, and creating engaging opportunities for medical students.

name: Mohammad Alazzam
bio: am a fourth-year medical student at Al-Balqa Applied University with a strong interest in cardiovascular diseases and cardiovascular health awareness. Through my involvement in CIG, I aim to contribute to raising awareness about cardiovascular diseases, promoting prevention, and making reliable health information more accessible to the community.

name: Shahed Nassar
bio: I am a sixth-year medical student passionate about cardiovascular medicine, medical education, and student engagement. Through the Cardiology Interest Group, with the aim of making cardiovascular knowledge more accessible and engaging for students and the wider community.

name: Islam Jarrar
bio: I am a second-year first-generation medical student, currently part of the Medical Education & Workshops team with the Cardiology Interest Group (CIG). I was drawn to cardiovascular medicine by the heart's remarkable paradox ,a small organ carrying an outsized role in sustaining life. Through CIG, I have helped organize educational booths, attended a scientific session alongside CIG, and took part in organizing and spreading awareness on heart disease risk factors with fellow members in our most recent activity.

Fascinated by the heart’s essential role in the body and advancements in cardiovascular medicine, currently contributing to the Cardiovascular Interest Group as a leader in team planning and management and active involvements in CIG projects.

As part of CIG’s Planning & Team Management Team, I hope to contribute to meaningful initiatives that provide students with diverse opportunities to learn, engage, volunteer, and connect with both the medical community and the wider community, while continuing to grow within the field of cardiology.

Through my work with CIG, I contribute to raising cardiovascular health awareness and fostering peer-to-peer clinical engagement
